title: Drop and Cover
author: Mara Blackwood
blurb: Silas Pemberton, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
